verdict: Purchases collapsed this week; ad spend is being rebalanced now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days your Meta ads delivered 29 purchases and a 4.86 return on ad spend, but the final days of this week brought that to a halt — zero purchases on August 9 and 10, confirmed by the data. The root cause is clear: one campaign absorbed 57% of your total ad budget while purchase volume dried up, creating a significant efficiency leak. We're reviewing that campaign's creative and audience targeting this week to stop the bleed and reallocate spend more effectively. Your Google Business Profile also went dark on August 9–10 after averaging 18 customer actions per day; we're checking the listing now and expect it resolved shortly. Next week should reflect a more balanced spend distribution and, with the live-cooking shoot on August 14 delivering fresh creative, a recovery in both ad performance and organic reach.
